name: GIGABYTE G27Q20 27 2K QHD 210Hz SuperSpeed IPS Gaming Monitor

descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE G27Q20 27 2K QHD 210Hz OC SuperSpeed IPS Gaming Monitor (27 Inch 2K 2560x1440 / 200Hz Native Overclockable to 210Hz / SuperSpeed IPS Panel / 0.5ms GTG Response Time / 94% DCI-P3 & 123% sRGB / HDR10 / AMD FreeSync Premium & G-Sync Compatible / DisplayPort & HDMI Ports / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Unlock competitive esports performance and crisp visuals with the GIGABYTE G27Q20 27-inch 2K QHD gaming monitor, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Featuring a 2560x1440 QHD resolution combined with a high-speed SuperSpeed IPS panel, this display delivers a ultra-fast 200Hz refresh rate (overclockable to 210Hz) and a rapid 0.5ms GTG response time for minimal ghosting and motion blur. With 94% DCI-P3 color gamut coverage, HDR10 support, AMD FreeSync Premium, G-Sync compatibility, and GIGABYTE tactical features like Aim Stabilizer Sync and OSD Sidekick, it is engineered for gamers and creators seeking precision and performance.
